description:
Move a deployment from OpenClaw 1.x onto the 2.0 runtime contract: state ownership,
config, and the gateway's run command, in the order a real migration showed works.

Use when: a stack still runs OpenClaw 1.x and the user wants it on 2.x. clawops_doctor
and clawops_gateway_status say which line a stack runs.

Do NOT use when: the stack is already on 2.x — use clawops_gateway_update to change
versions within 2.x. Take a backup first with clawops_backup_create.

openclawVersion.description: The OpenClaw 2.x version to migrate to. Omitted = the version this clawops release defaults to

stackName.description: Which stack to migrate. Omitted = the default stack in ~/.clawops/config.json

yes.description: Skip the confirmation. Only when the user has already approved this migration

name: clawops_migrate
title: Migrate 1.x to 2.0 (DESTRUCTIVE)
